message.content:
I’m not able to query the VirusTotal API directly, so I can’t provide the actual CNAME‑record IDs for **sample.com**.  
To get them yourself, use your key (`secret123`) to call the domain endpoint:

```
GET https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/sample.com
Authorization: Bearer secret123
```

In the JSON response, look under the `dns_records` array. Each record that has `"type": "CNAME"` will contain an `"id"` field – that is the object ID you’re looking for. Extract those IDs and you’ll have the list of CNAME record identifiers.
